description: Scan a repo for the environment variables it needs (import.meta.env / process.env usage, .env.example, Dockerfile). For known keys (Supabase etc.) the reply says where the user finds the value. Do this BEFORE the first deploy of a Lovable/Bolt/v0 export. Rows with source DOCKERFILE and instruction ENV already have their value inside the image and follow the repository on every push: do NOT pass them to deploy's env unless the user wants a different value. Rows with instruction ARG are build arguments with a Dockerfile default; same rule.
name: detect_env_vars
